description.p: Kurvenrausch is a racer in the spirit of OutRun and Lotus Esprit Turbo Challenge: a lap through Europe and the USA, drawn in chunky pixels with the classic segment-based pseudo-3D road.

ul.li: Ten zones around the world, from the Cote d'Azur through the lanes of England, the Netherlands, the rainy Black Forest, the snowy Alps and Tuscany to Arizona, the California coast, the hills of San Francisco and Japan
Forks where the road splits into two routes, and jumps over San Francisco's crests
Traffic of cars, vans, trucks and a rare rival that races you
Horn, nitro, fuel and gas stations, car dealers with four cars to choose from, a rear-view mirror and a mini map
Synthesised engine and effects, keyboard and gamepad with rumble
